title: Limit on Open Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Leases per Customer
content:
**Credit policy — number of open leases a customer may hold**

A customer may be the lessee on at most **3** open Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Leases at the same time.

**What counts as open**

A lease counts as open in every status except closed and charged off. A lease still pending funding counts. Kestrel New Vehicle Retail, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail and Kestrel Advantage Balloon contracts do not count toward this cap.

**Effect**

A booking that would take the customer over the cap is declined at funding review.

**Count table (hypothetical holdings, the new lease included in the count)**

| Leases already open (any status other than closed or charged off, pending funding included) | Other Kestrel retail, pre-owned or balloon contracts | New lease booked | Leases counted | Result at funding review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1 retail contract | 1 | 3 | within the cap |
| 3 | none | 1 | 4 | declined |
| 2, one of them charged off | none | 1 | 2 | within the cap |
| 2, one of them pending funding | 2 balloon contracts | 1 | 3 | within the cap |

**Questions the rule answers**

*Does a lease that has been turned in but not yet closed still count?* Yes. A returned or early-terminated lease is not closed or charged off, so it counts as open until it is closed or charged off.

*Does a Kestrel retail installment contract use up one of the three places?* No. Only leases count.
